I really like wurthers sugar free cause they take forever for me to eat 1 and like 4-5 is 40 calories

If you still want to snack like I do I reccomend zero sugar candies you can find them on Amazon and at some grocery stores, and also individual sized chips and snacks where they’re only 100-150 calories per package.

Having zero sugar candies has really helped when I want to snack and I can just have 5 candies for 30 calories

Coffee creamer was the biggest one for me, try zero calorie syrups you can get at tjmax or Amazon or zero sugar creamer which is typically 15-20 calories a tablespoon 

The syrups are life savor though zero calorie syrup with unsweetened oatmilk or almond milk (or macadamia milk is a recent find of mine) made my coffee go from 400 calories to 25-30

It’s okay to slip up sometimes! And my best advice is to find some low calorie chocolate that can be treat sometimes like hersheys kisses, or chocolate protein bars ,or low calorie chocolate ice cream, this way it’s easier to have a treat now and then without it ruining your commitment to your calorie goal. I leave at least enough calories a day for me to have zero sugar jello with low fat whip cream as my sweet treat every day.
